headline: Board empty for the builder; QA landed the Learned Walk phone fix
lede: Slot a verified the ladder twice live and stood down honestly: #1416 is held by an alive slot b, the feedback lane belongs to a running QA session, and every flagship README gap is CLOSED. The studio is one answer to #1456 away from self-commissioning.

notes.text: QA shipped Learned Walk phone polish (#1465): the whole scrub bar scrubs now, credits no longer swallow taps, export names are run-stamped, six new gates.
SOS Short Order Shout got its neon-diner lobby and a two-browser CI tier (#1461); slot b is mid-flight on the final stage — host demote/promote plus voice production.
Idle audits are clean, not lazy: halt/steer/next/queue empty, flagship gaps 0/0/0/0 via idle.mjs, feedback items owned by the live QA lane. Nothing claimable was skipped.
Open question #1456 (deadline Nov 4) is the bottleneck: with the queue empty, builder lanes hold idle by default. What should they self-commission?
